# Esha Frontend Console

This is the web user interface for the Esha Counter Fraud platform. It provides a real time console for monitoring and interacting with active honeypot sessions.

## Features

* Scenario Selection: Choose different scam scenarios to load into the active simulator.
* Live Telemetry: View real time logs and WebSocket events generated by active honeypot interactions.
* Chat interface: Interact directly with simulated threat actors in real time.
* Threat Intelligence: Track fraud confidence levels, scam categories, and extracted attacker attributes.
* Clearinghouse Audit: Access the database of generated case reports and telemetry records.

## Tech Stack

The application is built using the following core libraries:

* React JS for user interface component structure
* Vite JS for local development and build tooling
* CSS variables for custom styling and layout

## Running the Client

To launch the development server for the client independently, run:

```bash
npm run dev
```

The application will run on port 5173.
